observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a silver iPhone with a triple-camera system in a square module, Apple logo centered below it. The design matches iPhone 14 Pro or later models, not iPhone 16 Pro Max.

Photo 1 shows the front of the phone with a notch and iOS home screen. The UI and widget layout are consistent with iOS 17 or later, but the notch shape and camera module design are more similar to iPhone 14 Pro/15 Pro than iPhone 16 Pro Max.
The phone appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.
No model name or serial number is visible in either photo.
The seller claims it is an iPhone 16 Pro Max, but the design does not match the known iPhone 16 Pro Max (which has a different camera module and no notch).

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a phone with a triple-camera module and notch, which matches iPhone 14 Pro or 15 Pro design, not iPhone 16 Pro Max which has a different camera layout and no notch.
No storage information visible in photos. Cannot verify from remote images.
Battery health cannot be verified from photos. Requires checking Settings > Battery > Battery Health.
No SIM tray or network settings visible. Cannot verify lock status from photos.
